title: The Communication Bottleneck: A Round-Trip Study of Tree-Structured Expression Serialization in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.21509v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When language models reason in chain-of-thought or exchange free-text intermediates, they serialize structured information into natural language. How much tree-structured compositional content survives this bottleneck? We propose a round-trip protocol that answers this question empirically for tree-structured expressions. A generator converts a procedurally generated arithmetic expression into a word problem, a separate extractor recovers the expression from the word problem alone, and symbolic equivalence provides an exact oracle. Evaluating all pairwise combinations of sixteen models yields a communication matrix whose marginals separate generation quality from extraction quality. Three main findings emerge. First, the channel is lossy and asymmetric: swapping which model generates and which extracts shifts accuracy by up to 60.4 points, and the best pair reaches 92.9% by combining different models on each end rather than the same mode

translated_title: 通信瓶颈：语言模型中树结构表达式序列化的往返研究
translated_abstract: 当语言模型进行思维链推理或交换自由文本形式的中间结果时，它们会将结构化信息序列化为自然语言。有多少树结构的组合内容能够通过这一瓶颈而存活？我们提出了一种往返式协议，从实证角度回答了树结构表达式的这一问题。生成器将程序化生成的算术表达式转换为文字应用题，一个独立的提取器仅从文字应用题中恢复出表达式，而符号等价性判定提供了精确的评估基准。通过评估十六个模型的所有两两组合，我们得到了一个通信矩阵，其边际分布将生成质量与提取质量分离开来。研究得出三个主要发现。首先，该信道是有损且不对称的：交换哪个模型负责生成、哪个模型负责提取，会使准确率变化高达60.4个百分点，而最佳组合通过在两端使用不同模型（而非同一模型）达到了92.9%的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出一种往返式评估协议，通过生成器将算术表达式转为文字题、提取器再从文字题恢复表达式并以符号等价性精确验证，实证发现语言模型间的自然语言通信信道是有损且不对称的，最佳模型组合可达92.9%的准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a round-trip protocol to empirically measure how much tree-structured information survives serialization into natural language, revealing that the communication channel between language models is lossy and asymmetric, with the best model pair achieving 92.9% accuracy.
